title: Chained constructor property reads escape builtin lowering
summary: Accepted vec2(3,4).normalized is emitted unchanged, fails with nil global vec2, and does not bundle the runtime.

title: Game-math helper injection misses comments and bracket members
summary: math. --comment newline clamp(...) and math["clamp"](...) build successfully but execute without the required helper.

title: Nonzero tiny vector divisors incorrectly raise zero-component error
summary: The zero guard multiplies components; 1e-200 * 1e-200 underflows, rejecting valid component-wise division.

title: Normalization collapses finite large and small vectors to zero
summary: Vectors (1e200,0) and (1e-200,0) normalize to (0,0) rather than (1,0) through overflow/underflow in squared length.
